lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of larger spots in the mid-lateral area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three visible horizontal ridges along the upper flank exhibit a sharp intensity gradient, characterized by bright light along the superior edges and deep shadows immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-luminance spots across its dorsal surface.
